Page 25 Cont.
Feb. Julia Donovan (Sister of Honora) - 58 - In-goitre operated on 15 yrs. ago. It returned five yrs. ago .... has arthritis & Neuritis
Mrs.Lvejoy Valiquette - wants to settle court case out of court ...
Page 26 Charles Gaffney - 69 - reported dying in Miami Fl. - pneumonia mar- ried out of church and
Mrs. Cyrilla Hatch - 35 - ulcers - had operation yesterday in Jackson
Feb. 9 Raymond Dingler -6 - playing with another little boy received a punc- ture in his eye. Drs. fear for loss of the eye ... four yrs. ago his little brother was run over by auto and died - aged 6. Feb. 16 Re- ported to-day as "astonishing doctors". Can see Deo Gratias
John J. Molloy - 63 - Cataract removed from one Eye last week now the other eye is threatened
Nellie Culline - $10.00 City of God
Page 27
Feb. 11 Priscilla Danaher - 6 - Enrolled Jan. 28 as against scarlet fever, hooping cough & blood stream strep - given up by all her doctors home since Feb. 6 & O.K ... Drs. astonished Deo Gr!
11 Ignatius Zielinski - 45 - swolen sholder, has family of 6 depending
12 Evelyn Schick - 3 - Spinal maningitis - given up in Receiving Hospital. Enrolled by phone last night and this a.m. $1.00 - parents promising perpetual enrollment and more frequent Communion.
Mrs. Margaret - 19 - given up by Drs. Expecting twins - Enrolled.
14 David Sheehan - 69 - nerveous Brk'd. in St. Joseph's Retreat; had been .. drawing a salary of about $90. per month; was to be pen. - should of at 60 ... gave way to worry - lost balance.
14 Geo. Hyde -16-playing on a haystack in Emmett (Mich.) was pushed off and received serious injury of spine - 4 vertebrae crushed, to be in bed for a year
